title: Increasing the Fire of God in Our Lives
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner challenges believers to let go of their own selfish desires and ambitions, and instead seek a deeper surrender to God's will. As we navigate the last hour of time, Pastor Chris reminds us that true spiritual growth requires us to decrease and let Jesus increase in our lives. Join us as we explore the urgent call to surrender and obedience that will take us to the next level of our faith.
